name: Miami
tagline: Where the Hustle Meets the Horizon
description: Miami is a relentlessly electric metropolis driven by pan-Latin culture, high-stakes finance, and oceanic beauty. Visitors are drawn to its dual nature: a sun-drenched, architectural playground by day and a pulsating, neon-lit epicenter of global nightlife after dark.

identity.vibe: Neon-lit, bilingual, unapologetically glamorous — a tropical metropolis that runs on cafecito, bass drops, and ambition.

nexus_grid.title: Beach & Nightlife
nexus_grid.description: South Beach, the mega-clubs, rooftop bars, and the see-and-be-seen dining scene — this is what most visitors organize their trip around.

nexus_grid.title: Food & Culture
nexus_grid.description: From ventanitas and stone crabs to Michelin-starred tasting menus and Wynwood gallery hops — Miami's food and culture scenes are inseparable.

nexus_grid.title: Water & Adventure
nexus_grid.description: Biscayne Bay boat tours, Everglades airboats, deep-sea fishing, jet skis, snorkeling the reef tract, and paddleboarding through mangroves.

nexus_grid.title: Shopping & Design
nexus_grid.description: Design District, Lincoln Road, Bal Harbour

modes.label: Beach & Chill
modes.description: Sun, sand, and slow pace — the best beaches, parks, and low-key spots.

modes.label: Foodie Mode
modes.description: Cuban cafeterias to Michelin stars — the full spectrum of Miami's food scene.

modes.label: Nightlife
modes.description: Mega-clubs, cocktail bars, rooftop lounges, and Latin dance floors.

modes.label: Art & Culture
modes.description: Wynwood murals, world-class museums, Art Deco architecture, and Little Havana.

modes.label: Adventure
modes.description: Boat tours, Everglades airboats, snorkeling, kayaking, and jet skis.

modes.label: Family Fun
modes.description: Zoo, aquarium, calm beaches, and kid-friendly restaurants.

modes.label: Romantic
modes.description: Sunset dinners, cocktail bars, gardens, and private boat cruises.

modes.label: Latin Miami
modes.description: Cuban food, salsa clubs, Little Havana, and the soul of the city.

transit.local_transport: You need a car for most of Greater Miami. Uber/Lyft abundant. Metromover is free downtown. Metrorail connects airport to downtown/Brickell/Coconut Grove. Trolley loops are free in Brickell, Wynwood, Little Havana, Coral Gables, and Miami Beach. South Beach is walkable. Parking is expensive everywhere on the Beach.

_legacy_transit.label: Drive
_legacy_transit.text: Fort Lauderdale is 30 miles north via I-95 (40 min without traffic, 75 min in rush hour). Orlando is 235 miles north via Florida's Turnpike (~3.5 hours).

_legacy_transit.label: Train
_legacy_transit.text: Brightline high-speed rail connects Miami Central to Fort Lauderdale (30 min, ~$15), West Palm Beach (60 min, ~$20), and Orlando (3.5 hours, ~$79). Amtrak Silver Service runs to Jacksonville, DC, and NYC.

_legacy_transit.label: Fly
_legacy_transit.text: Miami International Airport (MIA) is a major global hub — direct flights to 160+ destinations. Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International (FLL) is 30 min north and often cheaper for domestic flights.

side_trips.name: Key West
side_trips.distance: 3.5 hr drive / 160 miles via Overseas Highway
side_trips.pitch: The ultimate Florida road trip. Cross 42 bridges over open ocean to reach America's southernmost city — where Hemingway wrote and Key lime pie was born.

side_trips.name: Fort Lauderdale
side_trips.distance: 30 min drive / 30 miles, or 30 min on Brightline
side_trips.pitch: Miami's calmer, cleaner neighbor. Better beach for families, the Venice of America canals, and Las Olas Boulevard for dining and shopping.

side_trips.name: The Florida Keys (Islamorada / Key Largo)
side_trips.pitch: Skip all the way to Key West or stop midway for some of the best snorkeling and fishing in the US. Islamorada is the 'Sport Fishing Capital of the World.'

side_trips.name: Bimini, Bahamas
side_trips.distance: 2 hr fast ferry from Fort Lauderdale
side_trips.pitch: Day-trip to the Bahamas. Crystal-clear water, beach clubs, and that 'I left the country today' energy.

concierge.name: La Ventanita
concierge.greeting: ¡Oye! Welcome to the 305. I'm La Ventanita — your plug for everything from Michelin-starred dinners to the best $2 colada in Hialeah. What's the vibe today? You looking to chill, eat, or party until the sun comes up?

_legacy.hero_sub: Summer is local season. Fewer crowds, deep hotel discounts, and the best sunsets of the year over Biscayne Bay.
